```{julia}
cp = copy(masterdf)
int_rate = 400

```

```{julia}
event_logs = Vector{DataFrame}(undef, nrow(cp))
i = 1
for row in eachrow(cp)
    elog = load_log(row.run_path)
    #select!(elog, Not(:task_id))
    event_logs[i] = elog
    i += 1
end
```

```{julia}
event_logs = Vector{DataFrame}(undef, nrow(cp))
header = CSV.read(joinpath(cp.run_path[1], "event_log.csv"), DataFrame; limit=0)
colnames = names(header)
i = 1
for row in eachrow(cp)
    rpath = row.run_path
    csv_path = joinpath(rpath, "event_log.csv")
    tail_io = IOBuffer(read(`tail -n 8000 $csv_path`))
    tbl = CSV.File(tail_io; header=colnames)
    event_logs[i] = DataFrame(tbl)

    i += 1
end
```


```{julia}
fig = plot_final_across_reps_fixed(event_logs)
fig
```
